name: Minato Shiori
source:
Class: Chrysanthemum, First Year
Club Affiliation: Sewing Club

A quiet, gentle, nondescript girl. However, she's quick-thinking and has a strong sense of self. She enjoys sewing and crocheting, and has a tendency to get lost in her own little world. When [url=/c97600]Mikoto[/url] asks her out, she senses something guarded about her that intrigues her. Although she doesn't understand Mikoto's true intentions, she decides to do her best to make things work between them. [url=/c97603]Aoi[/url] seems to like her and often talks to her, but she doesn't know what her intentions might be, either.

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1252]MangaGamer[/url]]
